features.name: Level 1 Operator progression
features.description:
Tip of the spear 
When you make an attack roll with a weapon you are proficient with you and up to 3 friendlies can take a free reaction and move up to half YOUR movement speed. 


Tactical Reloads
If you choose to reload a primary or secondary weapon that you are proficient with during your turn before it runs out it doesn't cost a bonus action 


Emergency Reloads/Transitions 
Should an attack roll made during a reaction make you run out of ammunition you automatically reload as part of the same reaction. If you have no more loaded magazines for that weapon you automatically switch to another equipped weapon.


When Wearing an armor you're proficient with your movement speed increases by 10.

features.name: Level 2 Operator progression
features.description:
Focus Fire
When engaging a target you can tell other friendlies to focus fire on the target. When you do so any friendlies that can see the target can use their reaction to make an attack roll against the target. Once you have focused fire on a target you cannot do it again until the original target has been killed.  And can only be done a number of times per long rest equal to your proficiency bonus.

features.name: Level 3 Operator progression
features.description: No additional class feature text was provided.

features.name: Level 4 Operator progression
features.description: No additional class feature text was provided.

features.name: Level 5 Operator progression
features.description: Follow Up Shot (extra attack)

features.name: Level 6 Operator progression
features.description: No additional class feature text was provided.

features.name: Level 7 Operator progression
features.description:
Tactical assault 
If the attack roll used to trigger tip of the spear was a hit the friendlies that moved can also make an attack roll as part of the same reaction. 


When you command focus fire 
Your friendlies can immediately use a free reaction to make one attack roll against the target. 
Additionally all attack rolls against the target are at advantage until it dies.

features.name: Level 8 Operator progression
features.description: feat/ability score increase

features.name: Level 9 Operator progression
features.description:
Overwhelming Assault 
Once per turn or reaction when you kill a target with a headshot your action or reaction is refreshed allowing you to attack again. Additionally you and upto 3 friendlies can take a free reaction to move your full movement speed.

features.name: Level 10 Operator progression
features.description: Subclass Ability

features.name: Level 11 Operator progression
features.description:
Weapon Mastery 
You no longer need to use a bonus action to reload weapons you are proficient with. Additionally when dealing with weapon malfunctions you no longer need to use a bonus action to clear the malfunction. You only need to inspect the weapon and have the tools required (if necessary)

features.name: Level 12 Operator progression
features.description:
Subclass Ability
Feat/Ability Score increase

features.name: Level 13 Operator progression
features.description:
Lethal Aggression 
Whenever you take the attack action after moving 10feet you gain advantage on both the attack roll and the d100 roll when/if determining the shot was a headshot.

features.name: Level 14 Operator progression
features.description:
Tier-1/Ability Score Increase
Subclass Ability

subclasses.name: Grenadier
subclasses.description: Grenadiers are masters of grenade launchers and other explosive devices.

features.name: Grenadier subclass selection features
features.description: Grenadiers are masters of grenade launchers and other explosive devices.

features.name: Grenadier level 3 features
features.description:
Heavy Artillery 
Starting at level three when the subclass is chosen you become Proficient with Shotguns, LMGs, all Grenade Launchers, Rocket Launchers, Mines and trip wire traps. Additionally you can craft improvised Explosives.


Suppressive Fire 
(Requires Belt Fed LMG)
As an action, you can choose one piece of cover or entry way (such as barriers doorways etc) that enemies are taking cover behind and choose to suppress it until the start of your next turn. When you suppress an area all enemies being suppressed have disadvantage on attack and headshot/OLPS rolls. Additionally if an enemy leaves cover and you can see them or tries to move through your suppressive fire they automatically take your weapon damage x2 for every 5 feet. you can also roll the D100 against them. (Once) 
If you have 16 strength or higher you can walk while suppressing.


Phatman 
Grenades and 40mm shells no longer add to your total weight. Reloading underbarrel Grenade Launchers no longer costs a bonus action.

features.name: Grenadier level 6 features
features.description:
Master of Ordnance
You have advantage on perception and slight of hand checks for finding and disarming enemy mines and trip wires 


Your explosive traps do not trigger from you or your allies. Your trap DC increases by 5 and deals an additional 3d8 damage to enemies. 


Heavy Hitter 
When you make a successful attack with a shotgun regardless of what ammo type you're using an enemy within 10 feet of the target of your choice will take the weapon damage as well. 
Additionally when making a successful attack with explosives you deal an additional 3d8 to each enemy in your AOE.

features.name: Grenadier level 10 features
features.description:
Speed loader 
Reloading Belt Fed LMGs or the Milkor M32A1 40mm  no longer costs you a full action and can be done during a bonus action.

features.name: Grenadier level 12 features
features.description:
EOD 
If you choose to use your reaction to lay down on top of a grenade you also make yourself resistant to force damage until the start of your next turn. 


As a reaction you can also shoot in coming overhead nades that you can see.

features.name: Grenadier level 14 features
features.description:
Peace Pipe 
You receive a corn cob pipe similar to Big Pipe's. (Player determines what it looks like). 
You can use this pipe as a bonus action in combat to recover from all non fatal and permanent injuries instantly.

subclasses.name: Breacher
subclasses.description: These Operators possess an unrivaled combination of Aggression and Tactical Superiority

features.name: Breacher subclass selection features
features.description: These Operators possess an unrivaled combination of Aggression and Tactical Superiority

features.name: Breacher level 3 features
features.description: Tactical Aggression

features.name: Breacher level 3 features
features.description:
Tools of the Trade
You receive the Ruhl Tech Compact Breaching kit which consists of 


Bolt Cutters w/h retractable grips


Sledge hammer w/h retractable grip 


Retractable Prybar

features.name: Breacher level 6 features
features.description:
Hot swap 
When an enemy comes within 10 feet of you, you can use your reaction to attack them with your pistol. When determining the damage you roll as if you made 3 attacks with Semiautomatic pistols or revolvers. If you have a full automatic pistol you treat it as a max bullet dice roll.

features.name: Breacher level 10 features
features.description:
Full Auto Mastery 
When shooting full auto you ignore the hot condition and do not roll with disadvantage on the d100 when determining headshots. 


You also gain the Mag Dump Action 
As an action you can pick upto 5 enemies within close proximity of eachother and shoot your entire magazine at them. When you do this you force them to make a dexterity saving throw. The dc is equal to 8 + proficiency + DEX  Modifier. On a failed save they each take the full damage. On a successful save they do not suffer any damage. 
The damage varies depending on what gun and current magazines are being used. But if we use an m4 w/h a stanag 60 for example it would work out to 60d6 damage.

features.name: Breacher level 12 features
features.description:
Knight's Perseverance 
Once per long rest When reduced to 0 hit points (except for headshots) you ignore all Damage on Turn effects for 1 minute you also do not go down and continue to fight until you have rolled 3 unsuccessful death saving throws. In which case you will go down and have to roll three more. However, if you roll 3 saves you not only stabilize yourself but you also regain half your hp.

features.name: Breacher level 14 features
features.description:
Knight's Trophy Collection 
You collect the dog tags and patches of fallen PMCs that you have killed and decorate your right arm with them. When you do this you receive different abilities. 


Patches (Max 5, can be mixed) 
USEC patch +1 to attack rolls per patch
BEAR Patch +1 to AC Per Patch 
Dog Tags (must be the same) 
With 20 USEC dog tags you gain the ability
 USEC Aggression 
+2 Initiative, You gain an additional action, Your movement speed increases by 50 and your Dexterity is increased by 4 to a maximum of 24. 
 With 20 BEAR Dog Tags you gain the ability 
Bear Raw Power 
+2 Constitution, You become Resistant to all Damage, and you cannot suffer from bleeds or dismemberment.

features.name: Level 1 CQB progression
features.description:
Prefire - Reaction
When an enemy makes an attack roll against you or a friendly within 10 feet of you that you can see. You can make an attack roll against their attack roll and if you roll higher they not only take your weapon damage but their attack is canceled. 


Shotgun Mastery
You automatically reload shotguns after firing. 
Additionally on a successful attack roll against an enemy target, once per turn upto 2 other enemies within 5 feet of the target take the weapon damage. 


Enhanced Peek 
When leaning from behind cover you gain +2 AC and attack rolls against you roll the d100 with disadvantage when determining if it was a headshot. 


Close Quarters Tactics 
On the first attack you make on your turn you gain +1 to attack and damage rolls (maximum 5) for each enemy within 10 feet.

features.name: Level 2 CQB progression
features.description:
Enhanced Stealth Takedowns
When attempting a stealth takedown you have advantage on the roll. Additionally, you can attempt a stealth takedown on targets around corners even if they're facing the direction you're coming from 


Melee Combat 
When attacking with a melee weapon you can use  1d8+STR to determine the damage. Attacks with one handed melee weapons can be made with an action or bonus action. You can also choose upto 2 effects to impose on the target. Once an effect is used it cannot be used again until you finish a long rest. 


Disarming Strike 
You disarm the target of the weapon they're currently using. If you need a weapon you automatically equip it, if not the weapon is kicked away as part of the same action 


Knock Prone 
You knock the target prone 


Weapon Malfunction 
You hit the weapon in such a way that you manage to cause it to malfunction somehow.

features.name: Level 3 CQB progression
features.description: Choose Subclass

features.name: Level 4 CQB progression
features.description: Ability increase/feat

features.name: Level 5 CQB progression
features.description:
Follow up shot
When you use your action to attack with a weapon you are proficient with you can make another action so long as it also an attack roll.

features.name: Level 6 CQB progression
features.description: Subclass ability

features.name: Level 7 CQB progression
features.description:
Close Quarters Tactics 
Your bonuses for being near enemies are no longer capped at at once per turn. 


The range of your prefire is extended to 30 feet
You can also choose 2 additional Melee effects 


Blinding Slash 
You slash an enemies eyes permanently blinding them. Enemies are immune if wearing a face shield or other full face ballistic protection. 


Stripping Strike 
With a successful d100 roll you can knock a targets helmet off their head.

features.name: Level 8 CQB progression
features.description: Feat/Ability score increase

features.name: Level 9 CQB progression
features.description:
Peripheral Processing 
When holding an Angle and an enemy flanks you, you can use your reaction to make an attack roll against them. 
Additionally, already in combat and additional enemies appear. You can use your reaction to make one attack roll against a number of enemies equal to your proficiency bonus so long as the targets are not completely out of your sight when they enter.

features.name: Level 10 CQB progression
features.description:
Subclass Ability 


Close Quarters Tactics
Your bonuses for being near enemies are now capped at +10


Grappling
After making a successful melee attack against an enemy you can choose to try to grapple them. If successful the target is restrained and you can choose to do one of the following 


Field Strips
You can use your bonus action to disassemble one of their weapons. When you choose to this the target is knocked prone and the grapple ends. 


Human Shield 
You can use the enemy as total cover to move through sustained fire or be saved from attack rolls so long as the target is alive.

features.name: Level 11 CQB progression
features.description:
Close Quarters Tactics 
When engaging enemies within 30 feet or less your DCs on the D100 are decreased by 10. Per enemy. (Maximum of 50) 
Additionally Shotguns can now be fired with only a Bonus action.

features.name: Level 12 CQB progression
features.description:
Feat/ABI 
Subclass Ability

features.name: Level 13 CQB progression
features.description:
Iron Skull 
You can now wear medium and heavy armored helmets without penalty. (With the exception of those caused by certain Face shields)

features.name: Level 14 CQB progression
features.description:
Tier-1 
Subclass Ability

subclasses.name: Enforcer
subclasses.description: Elite Specialists in hand to hand combat and close quarters engagements. These soldiers excel in highly aggressive tactics in tight spaces.

features.name: Enforcer subclass selection features
features.description:
Elite Specialists in hand to hand combat and close quarters engagements. These soldiers excel in highly aggressive tactics in tight spaces. 


Starting at level 3 when this subclass is chosen you gain the ability to roll the D100 to determine headshots with melee weapons. Additionally the number of times you can use additional melee effects increases to a number equal to your proficiency bonus. 


Penetrating Strike 
When using a melee weapon to determine a headshot if the target is wearing head/face protection that cannot be avoided you can ignore it if your strength modifier is equal to or higher than the armour class. 
However, when you do this the ignored armour is automatically ruined beyond repair.

features.name: Enforcer level 6 features
features.description:
Weapon Jam Aura 
Once per Long Rest if you start your turn only holding a melee weapon you can select up to five targets within 10 feet of you and cause their weapons to malfunction. When used against Scav Bosses, or other Elite Enemies they have to roll an Armaments check against your Strength Score. 


Martial Artist 
You gain an additional reaction per round.
When an Enemy within five feet of you makes an attack roll you can use your reaction to attempt a disarming strike.

features.name: Enforcer level 10 features
features.description:
Heavy Hitter
You deal extra damage equal to your proficiency bonus when using melee weapons. 


Weapon Jam Aura
Your Weapon Jam aura can be used twice per long rest.

features.name: Enforcer level 12 features
features.description:
Kollontay's Weapon Mastery 
When using The KS-23M or any variation you gain the following benefits. 
+3 to attack and damage rolls
The target automatically fails any constitution saves against additional ammunition effects. 
You automatically reload at the end of your turn

features.name: Enforcer level 14 features
features.description:
Kollontay's Jam Aura 
Once per round you can select up to 5 enemies that you are aware of and cause their weapons to automatically malfunction. 


Martial Artist 
You gain an additional reaction per round (3 total)

subclasses.name: Medic
subclasses.description: Medics are Soldiers who specialize in the medical field. Capable of utilizing medical supplies much more efficiently.

features.name: Medic subclass selection features
features.description:
Medics are Soldiers who specialize in the medical field. Capable of utilizing medical supplies much more efficiently.


Starting at level three when the subclass is chosen. You gain the ability to heal teammates while in combat. You only use 150 hp to stop heavy bleeds with IFAKs and AFAKs or 50 HP to stop Light bleeds. 


Big Pharma 
You can now craft medical supplies and combat stimulants. Medical supplies such as first aid packs and tourniquets only require that you have  the needed supplies. At level 3 you can craft Propital regenerative and SJ1 Combat Stimulants.  You learn to craft more stimulants at higher levels or by studying them in places with specialized equipment and samples.

features.name: Medic level 6 features
features.description:
CPR Revival 
If a friendly has died within one minute and you don't have a defibrillator you can attempt to use CPR to revive them. (Does not work if the target has been headshot) 


Call an Ambulance... 
When you use your action to heal a friendly you can make one attack roll with your primary weapon during your bonus action. 


Big Pharma 
You learn how to craft SJ6, Zagustin and M.U.L.E Stimulants

features.name: Medic level 10 features
features.description:
When you use a med pack to stop a bleed you can roll the d20. If the roll is 10 or higher you do not consume any of the medpack's hp to stop the bleed. 


Sanitar's CMS Kit
You receive Sanitar's CMS kit. This CMs kit contains special tools that when used by you and only you has infinite uses. Additionally this kit can also be used to reattach limbs. To do this you must succeed a DC 10 medicine check. The DC increases by 5 each time you reattach the same limb onto the same person. 


Big Pharma 
You learn how to craft the N-1 & Melidonin stimulants and prosthetic legs.

features.name: Medic level 12 features
features.description:
Toxic Ammunition 
You learn how to craft Cultist Toxin and Toxic Ammunition. Targets shot by you automatically suffer the effects of Cultist Toxin immediately.

features.name: Medic level 14 features
features.description:
Sanitar's Vitality 
Your maximum HP increases by 150, you do not suffer the negative effects of stimulants and  painkillers. Their positive effects last twice as long. 


Sanitar's Surgery 
When using Medkits to stop heavy or light bleeds you do not consume any of the medpacks HP. Using Medpacks and surgery kits on yourself can now be done during a bonus action. Stimulants no longer cost a bonus action. 


Sanitar's Cruelty 
You can revive recently fallen enemies and use a drug concoction to immediately turn them against their friendlies for 1 minute and then their heart explodes. 


Big Pharma 
You know how to craft all stimulants.

options.name: Glukhar's Toughness
options.description: Ignore all additional ammunition effects, including dismemberment from high-caliber weapons.

options.name: Shturman's Precision

options.name: Reshala's Delicacy

features.name: One Man Army subclass selection features
features.description:

Starting at level 3
When this subclass is chosen you become proficient with SMGs and your movement speed when wearing heavy armor is doubled. 


I do not know why I'm here...

Adrenaline Points
You gain Adrenaline Points equal to twice your level.  (6) The maximum number of Adrenaline Points you can have increases at each level by one. You regain all spent Adrenaline Points after taking a long rest. These adrenaline points allow you to shrug off wounds that would otherwise be life changing or Fatal. When you take damage you can use a free reaction to spend one or more adrenaline points to 
1 Ignore Additional Ammunition Effects
1 Reduce the damage done to you and your armor by half 
2 Retaliate against the attacker

features.name: One Man Army level 6 features
features.description:
Increased Penetration 
When using any type of ammunition that is not a hollow or soft point your bullets can pierce through light concrete barriers and steel walls or objects that are not being worn by another person. 


Zig Zag 
When an enemy makes an attack roll against you, you can choose to spend 3 adrenaline points and Zig Zag through their attack. When you do this you take no damage and can choose to spend an additional adrenaline point to retaliate.

features.name: One Man Army level 10 features
features.description:
Killa's Helmet 
When shot in the head while wearing a helmet if the bullet succeeds the ricochet saving throw you can choose to spend one Adrenaline point to cause the round to ricochet BEFORE the dm declares if the round has high enough penetration to bypass the helmet. 


Killa's Power Slide 
As an action you can choose to spend 4 Adrenaline points to immediately move to an enemy that is 10 feet or less away from you or an ally that is no further away from you than 50 feet and immediately open fire on them. When you do this you force them to make a dexterity saving throw. DC equal to 8+prof+Dex or Str which ever is higher 
On a failed save the enemy takes your normal weapon damage plus a d10 for each adrenaline point spent. While determining the damage you can choose to spend additional Adrenaline points to increase the damage. On a successful save the target only takes half damage. Can be used as a reaction when an enemy makes an attack roll against you or a friendly, however even if the target dies their attack still hits you.

features.name: One Man Army level 12 features
features.description:
Killa's Constitution 
You no longer need to spend Adrenaline Points to shrug off serious injuries. You simply cannot be affected by any additional ammunition effects.

features.name: One Man Army level 14 features
features.description:
The Stylish One 
You gain a Tracksuit that resembles Killa's. Wearing it causes any scav to ignore you unless attacked. The tracksuit can be worn under any armor and gives additional benefits. When wearing your tracksuit your movement speed increases by 30, you gain +2 initiative and AC. 
The cost of all offensive Adrenaline point abilities are reduced by 2 to a minimum of 1. Additionally you do not need to spend adrenaline points to reduce damage.

subclasses.name: Berserker
subclasses.description: Mad men and Stimulant Fiends or both in Tagilla's case. These Juggernauts have gone Berserk. In combat they often use overwhelming firepower to close in on their enemies only to abandon their guns for brutal melee weapons.

features.name: Berserker subclass selection features
features.description: Mad men and Stimulant Fiends or both in Tagilla's case. These Juggernauts have gone Berserk. In combat they often use overwhelming firepower to close in on their enemies only to abandon their guns for brutal melee weapons.

features.name: Berserker level 3 features
features.description:
Defensive Savagery 
When you find a new vest or plate carrier you immediately tear it apart giving it a savage appearance and making it lighter. If you and only you equip this armour you gain +2AC. 
Additionally When wearing your savage armour and facemask your movement speed doubles. 


Berserk 3/Day (Berserker- Juggernaut Subclass) 
When you become aware of nearby enemies you gain the ability to go Berserk. Berserk can last for upto 10 minutes. When you do so you gain the following benefits 


While Berserk you cannot drop below 1HP. (unless headshot or other fatal injuries.)


You have advantage on attack rolls with melee weapons and deal extra damage equal to your proficiency bonus. 


However when Berserk you can hardly control yourself often yelling and screaming like a mad man. Each turn you spend Berserk 
Gives you a -5 to attack rolls with firearms. This can stack all the way up to -15 and lasts until the end of your Berserk state. Every 1 minute you must roll a wisdom saving throw on a failed save you lose the ability to distinguish between friend and foe for 2 turns.

features.name: Berserker level 6 features
features.description:
Intimidating Aura 
When you enter the Berserk state Scavs within 10 feet of you immediately become frightened of you. When they become frightened of you they drop their current weapon and spend their turn using all their movement to get away from you. Does not work on Scav Bosses. 


Maniac's Hand 
When an enemy within 5 feet of you hits you with an attack roll you can use a reaction to drop a grenade at your foot.

features.name: Berserker level 10 features
features.description:
Savage Assault 
When you make an attack roll with a melee weapon while Berserk your damage bonus is doubled and you can make one additional attack with your bonus action. Your movement speed increases by 20. 


You can now Craft level 6 face masks

features.name: Berserker level 12 features
features.description:
Savage Aura 
Your Aura can now effect scavs upto 20 feet away and can force enemy PMC to make wisdom saving throws. (DC 8 + proficiency + STR Modifier)

features.name: Berserker level 14 features
features.description:
Tagilla's Madness
Berserk only ends when you die or choose to end it. 
When you go Berserk you gain an additional +4 armor class, are now immune to dismemberment, DOT effects and are capable of surviving one headshot per Berserk state. If you are headshot by an enemy and survive you can use a reaction to retaliate against them. So long as they are no more than 20 feet away. You rush to them without provoking opportunity and attack with advantage. If the attack hits you double your damage rolled and the target suffers dismemberment. (You choose the limb they lose) additionally all attack rolls against you have disadvantage for the next minute. 


The Factory Butcher 
You only need to roll an 18 or higher to roll a critical hit. When you roll a critical hit with a melee weapon while Berserk your weapon causes them to suffer dismemberment.

subclasses.name: Kingpin
subclasses.description: These Juggernauts value heavy weapons and more ammunition over heavy ballistic protection. Suppressing large numbers of enemies with only sheer overwhelming firepower.

features.name: Kingpin subclass selection features
features.description:
These Juggernauts value heavy weapons and more ammunition over heavy ballistic protection. Suppressing large numbers of enemies with only sheer overwhelming firepower. 


Starting at level 3 when this subclass is chosen you gain a large trench coat that allows you to carry more ammunition. Only un armoured tactical rigs can be worn under your trench coat. When wearing your trench coat instead of armour your AC is equal to 10+STR+CON. 


Enhanced Suppression 
When you use Suppressive fire all effected enemies must roll a constitution saving throw. On a failed save the effected enemy receives the Pinned condition and is considered stunned until the start of your next turn. 
The DC is equal to 8+STR+Prof

features.name: Kingpin level 6 features
features.description:
Turret Stealer 
Starting at level 6 you gain the ability to rip large mounted weapons (such as AGS & 23mm MGs) off of their tri pods and carry them until they run out of ammunition.

features.name: Kingpin level 10 features
features.description:
Kaban's Terror
While suppressing you can use your bonus action to Laugh like Kaban. When you choose to do this you force all affected enemies to make an additional charisma saving throw at disadvantage. 
DC= 8+STR+PROF
On a failed save
The effected enemy is pinned until the end of your next turn. 
Enemies that were already pinned are now pinned for an additional round. 
On a successful save The effected the effected enemy is frightened until the start of your next turn. 
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus.

features.name: Kingpin level 12 features
features.description:
Kaban's Felina
When you use the Felina action against enemies that were not already aware of you, they automatically fail the saving throw and suffer maximum damage. 


Kaban's Arm
Your Strength is Added to your attack and damage rolls twice

features.name: Kingpin level 14 features
features.description:
Kaban's Defence 
You Gain Kaban's Trench coat. While wearing Kaban's trench coat you gain +2 to AC additional plate carriers can be worn under it without losing the benefits from Unarmored Defence. 


Kaban's Constitution 
You can no longer suffer additional ammunition effects.

features.name: Level 1 Scout progression
features.description:
Scouts honor 
When this class is chosen you become Proficient in Stealth and Survival. Additionally you have advantage on perception checks.


Unarmored Defense 
When not wearing any ballistic protection your AC is determined by 10+DEX&WIS


Plain Sight
When unarmored and away from your friendlies enemy PMC have a harder time determining your affiliation. Any enemy PMC more than 20 feet away from you will be hesitant to engage you unless given a reason to. 


Hold Breath
As a bonus action you can choose to hold your breath. When you do this your movement speed is halved and your DCs on the D100 are decreased by 10. Ends at the end of your turn.

features.name: Level 2 Scout progression
features.description:
DOPE
Because of your Data on Previous Engagements with various rifles, calibers, and optics. When using DMRs or Bolt Action Rifles you are able to ignore your weapon's MOA. 


Unarmored Movement 
Your movement speed increases by 20ft when not wearing any armor.

features.name: Level 3 Scout progression
features.description: Choose Subclass

features.name: Level 4 Scout progression
features.description: Feat/ABI Increase

features.name: Level 5 Scout progression
features.description: When making a successful headshot against a target wearing a helmet, before the bullet rolls the ricochet save you can choose to skip it. You can do this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per short or long rest.

features.name: Level 6 Scout progression
features.description: Subclass Ability

features.name: Level 7 Scout progression
features.description:
Counter Intelligence 
You gain the ability to listen in on nearby enemy radio communication. If you do not speak russian you will only understand certain words when listening in on BEARs or other Russian enemies. 


Unarmored Movement
Your movement speed increases by an additional 20ft when not wearing armor.

features.name: Level 8 Scout progression
features.description: Feat/ABI

features.name: Level 9 Scout progression
features.description:
Billy Goat 
Your movement speed increases an additional 30 ft and Rocky/difficult land terrain can no longer slow you down. Additionally you gain the Red Rebel Ice pick and can use it to climb moutains or large rocks.

features.name: Level 10 Scout progression
features.description: Subclass Ability

features.name: Level 11 Scout progression
features.description:
Perfect Sight 
When wearing NVGs or T-7 Thermal Goggles you can still look through optics. However, this does NOT increase/ignore the range limit of the goggles. Any other glass cannot be seen through with T-7s.

features.name: Level 12 Scout progression
features.description:
Subclass Ability 
Feat/ABI Increase

features.name: Level 13 Scout progression
features.description:
Aim Small, Miss Small
After failing the d100 roll when determining if an attack was a headshot the attack is automatically considered to be a critical hit.

features.name: Level 14 Scout progression
features.description:
Tier-1 
Subclass Ability

features.name: Hidden in Plain Sight & Hold Breath
features.description:
Hidden in plain sight 
When not wearing a helmet or other military gear most enemies will have a hard time determining your faction and are reluctant to open fire until shown otherwise.


As a bonus action you can choose to hold your breath until the end of your turn. When you do this your DC on the d100 for hitting more specific parts of the head (eyes,ears,nape etc) is the same as your regular headshot dc.

subclasses.name: Ghost
subclasses.description: Hidden in plane sight these scouts are equipped with Ghillie suits. They are masters of  extended long range shooting and camouflage. However they often operate at far distances from their squad and encounter their own problems.

features.name: Ghost subclass selection features
features.description:
Hidden in plane sight these scouts are equipped with Ghillie suits. They are masters of  extended long range shooting and camouflage. However they often operate at far distances from their squad and encounter their own problems. 
Starting at level 3 when the subclass is chosen you gain the following benefits. 


Already Dead
When engaging targets while hidden/sneaking or targets that haven't already had a turn in combat you gain advantage on the attack roll and when determining the damage you add 4d6 piercing damage. The number of D6s increases at level 6, 9 and 14.


Zryachiy's Eyes (Ghost- Scout Subclass)
Your eyes turn white like a blind person's. However you're not blind and can now see at night as if it was broad day. When wielding Bolt Action rifles you only need to roll a 25 or higher on the D100 to hit a headshot or 50 and higher for more specific shots such as eyes, ears, throat, etc. You also have advantage on perception checks. 


Ghillie Up 
You have become a master of hiding in your environment. When entering a new area or returning to an area you're already familiar with you can quickly gather things around you to make your Ghillie suit more effective in your environment. These can include leaves, pieces of tall grass small sticks/tree branches, or even garbage and other small things found in urban environments. When you do so you gain advantage on stealth checks.

features.name: Ghost level 6 features
features.description:
Cold Blooded
You have trained your body to match the temperature of your surroundings making you nearly impossible to detect with thermal imaging. 
Additionally when wielding a Bolt Action Sniper you can now engage targets another 500 meters out 


Zryachiy's Hot swap
When you use your action to fire a bolt action rifle you can use your bonus action to make 2 attack rolls with your pistol 


Cult Tactics 
You receive a ceremonial Cultist Dagger and gain proficiency with it. 
You automatically become aware of enemy targets that come within 20 feet of you. When you are in stealth you have advantage on stealth takedowns with your cultist dagger. 


Already Dead 
+2 D6

features.name: Ghost level 9 features
features.description: Already Dead +2 d6

features.name: Ghost level 10 features
features.description: Slow breathing

features.name: Ghost level 12 features
features.description:
Zryachiy's Hand 
When you pull the bolt back on a bolt action rilfe you load a round into the chamber before finishing the cycle. Allowing you to avoid reloading

features.name: Ghost level 14 features
features.description:
The One Who Sees 
From your sniper positions your eyes detect any target no matter how hard they hide. Not even Cultists can hide from you. 


The Lighthouse Keeper 
When firing upon an enemy that is between 150-1000 feet away from you, if the d20 roll hits the target automatically dies from a "Gunshot wound" to the head.

subclasses.name: Sharpshooter Radioman
subclasses.description: Equipped with Long Range Communication Radios these scouts play key roles in providing their teams with various types of information as well as support from base and other allies in Tarkov. Birdeye will tattoo your hand and dress you with a mexican sweater & fanny pack similar to his while you're sleeping.

features.name: Sharpshooter Radioman subclass selection features
features.description: Equipped with Long Range Communication Radios these scouts play key roles in providing their teams with various types of information as well as support from base and other allies in Tarkov. Birdeye will tattoo your hand and dress you with a mexican sweater & fanny pack similar to his while you're sleeping.

features.name: Sharpshooter Radioman level 3 features
features.description:
When this subclass is chosen you immediately receive a special backpack that contains your radio. This radio can be used to contact base and request helicopter extraction or relocation. Perhaps even the BTR driver could also be called. Additionally the radio can also be used to complete certain quests and accept new quests without having to return to base or trader location. (Rewards are sent to Water Treatment) 


Bird's Eye 
You can choose to spend time during a long rest to familiarize yourself with a weapon that you are proficient with. When you do so you give the weapon a name. You also gain the following benefits 
When using a familiarized weapon that is a marksman or bolt action rifle that has a rifle scope equipped (minimum 3x magnification) you only need to roll a 25 or higher on the d100 or 50 or higher for more specific shots. 
When making an attack roll with a familiarized Marksman or Bolt Action rifle you can choose to shoot twice 
Additionally you can see a mile further in any weather condition so long as it is during the day. 


Master of Angles 
When wielding a rifle you are able to engage targets while you're behind total cover

features.name: Sharpshooter Radioman level 6 features
features.description:
Birdeye's Release Audio 
Except for when firing unsuppressed weapons and talking.  You make no noise because somehow someone forgot to add that to you for 2 whole years.


Bombardment 
Once Per Long Rest the Radio can be used to request mortar fire.

features.name: Sharpshooter Radioman level 10 features
features.description:
Dead Eye 
When you kill an enemy with a headshot your DCs on the d100 decrease by 5. This will continue to stack until both DCs reach 0 and lasts until you miss a headshot or take a long rest. Your passive perception increases by 5. Additionally when outside during the day half your extended vision range is a 360 degree radius. Centered on you.

features.name: Sharpshooter Radioman level 12 features
features.description:
Counter Sniper
Whenever you engage or are engaged by an enemy your friendlies automatically know exactly where they are. Even if the enemy is hiding.

features.name: Sharpshooter Radioman level 14 features
features.description:
Bird Eye's Trophy Collection 
You collect the patches of PMCs you've killed. These patches can be mixed and give different bonus based on Faction. Maximum of 10.
USEC Patches
Your headshot DCs on the D100 are decreased by 1 for each USEC patch. 
BEAR Patches 
+1 AC per bear patch. 


USEC Long Range Optics 
If all 10 patches are USEC:
you can no longer miss attack rolls with sniper rifles and DMRs and you always have advantage on the d100 when determining headshots. 


BEAR Heavy Caliber 
If all 10 patches are Bear Patches:
When you make an attack roll with .338 or higher caliber rifles you automatically inflict maximum damage and all additional ammunition effects

subclasses.name: Hunter
subclasses.description: Hunters are scouts that specialize in ambush tactics and explosives.

features.name: Hunter subclass selection features
features.description:
Hunters are scouts that specialize in ambush tactics and explosives.


Starting at level 3 when this subclass is chosen you become proficient with Underbarrel grenade launchers, and trip wire traps. You learn how to craft grenades and 40mm shells. Additionally, you have a sudden fondness of Birds and can form unique friendships with them. Your Trap DC is equal to 8+Prof+WIS 




Hunter's Companion 
You can use a free action to whistle. When you do so you summon your Bird Companion. Bird companions can have unique uses depending on the species. However, all bird companions will be able to find and retrieve small items you might find useful. You can only have one bird as a companion at a time. Your Bird can be one of the following 
Great Tit 
Hooded Crow
Mallard (The Most Abundant Duck Species) 
Western Capercaillie (Large Grouse) 
Great Grey Owl (Night only)
White Tailed Sea Eagle
Siberian Accentor 
Siberian Black Bird 
Alexandrine Parakeet (Can be taught simple words and sentences) 


Favorite Prey 
You can choose one faction to become your favorite prey. When one faction becomes your favorite prey you have an easier time tracking and attacking them. You have advantage on perception, investigation and attack rolls against them. You can change your favorite prey during a short or long rest.

features.name: Hunter level 5 features
features.description: Follow up Shot/Extra Attack

features.name: Hunter level 6 features
features.description:
Samsara Wheel
Your bird companion can now recognize your favorite prey and will repeatedly circle around their position in the sky revealing their location to you and your squad. You can also spend one long rest teaching it how to drop a grenade.


Crow Swarm 
Once per 2 Long Rests you are able to summon a swarm of crows. These Crows caw loudly and ruthlessly assault upto 10 enemies of your choosing. If any of the enemies are not wearing full face protection the crows will peck their eyes out and permanently blind them. All enemies attacked by the Swarm suffer 80 damage.

features.name: Hunter level 10 features
features.description:
Hunter's Paradise 
You can now have upto 2 factions marked as your favorite prey. When you attack your favorite prey you now roll the d100 with advantage against them when determining headshots or other Low Percentage Shots.

features.name: Hunter level 12 features
features.description:
Hunter's Intuition 
When an enemy you cannot see is making an attack roll against you the hair on the back of your neck stands up. You can use your reaction to dive just as they pull the trigger.

features.name: Hunter level 14 features
features.description:
Partisan's Prey 
You automatically become aware of enemies hiding in bushes, or other "Rat" spots. You have advantage on attack and headshot rolls against these enemies, these enemies automatically fail on saving throws against your explosives, and take double the damage. 


Partisan's Trophy Collection 
Patches must be mixed to acquire the ultimate ability. (Max 10) 
USEC Patches (Per Patch) 
+1 attack rolls 
-1 Headshot DC 
BEAR Patches (Per Patch) 
+1 CON
+1 AC
5 USEC & 5 BEAR 
The Norvinsk Reaper 
Difficult Terrain can no longer slow you down.
You no longer need materials to craft explosives.

affiliations.name: Zaslon
affiliations.description: While officially Zaslon operates as security detail for the Kremlin and the Russian Prime Minister, the unit specializes in HVT assassination and retrieval, counter-intelligence, hostage rescue, and document retrieval.

features.name: Zaslon Operative
features.description: You can understand and speak Russian, have expertise with the Armament skill, and are proficient with all types of ballistic protection.

affiliations.name: U.S. Army
affiliations.description: Army Strong. Your carry weight doubles and you can travel on foot significantly longer than others before needing to eat and drink.

features.name: Army Strong
features.description: Your carry weight doubles and additionally you can travel on foot significantly longer than others before needing to eat and drink.

affiliations.name: Canadian Army
affiliations.description: Vigilamus Pro Te. Referred to as ?Crazy Canucks,? ?Stormtrupp?n,? and ?Savages? for their brutal night raids and ruthlessness during the world wars.

features.name: Vigilamus Pro Te
features.description: The Canadian Infantry is known as one of the most effective armed forces around the globe. You have a permanent +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls, may reroll damage once per turn and use whichever result is higher, and cannot suffer negative effects from cold weather.

affiliations.name: Green Berets
affiliations.description: De Oppresso Liber. Known as ?The Snake Eaters,? Green Berets frequently operate behind enemy lines.

features.name: De Oppresso Liber
features.description: From your experiences raising militias to overthrow governments you have learned to speak Russian, gained expertise in Persuasion and Deception, and learned Krav Maga.

affiliations.name: MARSOC
affiliations.description: Always Forward. Marine Raiders are pioneers of amphibious light infantry and frequently carry out counter-terrorism and direct-action missions around the globe.

features.name: Always Forward
features.description: You cannot be slowed by difficult terrain on land or in water and have advantage on Perception checks. If you use your action to heal a friendly, you can use your bonus action to attack with your primary weapon.

affiliations.name: U.S. Marines
affiliations.description: Semper Fi. The USMC earned the name ?Devil Dogs? for its fighting at Belleau Wood and specializes in rapid response and amphibious assault.

features.name: Semper Fi
features.description: Once per long rest, while in combat, use a bonus action to double your movement speed. When an ally you can see is attacked, use your reaction to retaliate against the attacker if they are within line of sight and effective range.

affiliations.name: SEALs
affiliations.description: The Only Easy Day Was Yesterday. The U.S. Navy SEALs conduct strike operations, counter-terrorism, and underwater reconnaissance; in wartime they also act as force multipliers.

features.name: The Only Easy Day Was Yesterday
features.description: You have Expertise in Stealth and advantage on Stealth checks in water or forest environments. In water your movement doubles, even when swimming. You know Krav Maga and can still fight while swimming or falling.

affiliations.name: Royal Marines
affiliations.description: Per Mare, Per Terram. The Royal Marines are the UK amphibious infantry, specializing in anti-piracy and arctic warfare.

features.name: Per Mare, Per Terram
features.description: You cannot suffer negative effects from cold weather; have Expertise in Stealth and advantage on Stealth checks in water or urban environments; water does not impose difficult terrain; and you know Commando CQC.

affiliations.name: CJIRU
affiliations.description: Nunquam Nonparati. Canada?s Joint Incident Response Unit is a secretive Tier-2 special forces unit specializing in CBRN threats.

features.name: Nunquam Nonparati
features.description: You cannot suffer negative effects from cold weather, have Expertise in Technology, and do not suffer negative effects from stimulants. You receive a level 3 armored gas mask wearable with helmets and night vision. At levels 6 and 9 you learn to craft level 4 and level 5 armored gas masks.

affiliations.name: British SAS
affiliations.description: Who Dares Wins. Pioneer of modern special forces, specializing in hostage rescue, counter-aircraft hijacking, direct action, covert reconnaissance, and revolutionary warfare.

affiliations.name: Australian SAS (SASR)
affiliations.description: Who Dares Wins. Direct descendant of the British SAS and Australia?s Tier-1 force, specializing in maritime counter-terrorism, strategic reconnaissance, high-risk surgical raids, tracking and neutralizing high-value targets, and precision airstrikes.

affiliations.name: DEVGRU
affiliations.description: The U.S. Navy?s Tier-1 unit, specializing in capture or elimination of high-value targets, clandestine operations, and disposal of weapons of mass destruction behind enemy lines.

affiliations.name: Delta
affiliations.description: Surrepsit. The U.S. Army?s Tier-1 unit, specializing in hiding in plain sight, battlefield preparation, and highly classified rapid-response operations.

affiliations.name: JTF2
affiliations.description: Facta Non Verba. Canada?s Tier-1 special force group, known for operational secrecy and specialization in arctic warfare.

affiliations.name: Jaeger Corps
affiliations.description: Plus Esse Quam Simulatur. Denmark?s Tier-1 special forces group, specializing in extreme-environment warfare, counter-terrorism, and unconventional warfare.
